title: Spec v0.8: 1Password plaintext-secret inventory + migration advisor

comments.author: anon-31e9bd66
comments.content: Spec written: docs/specs/2026-06-23-1password-secret-migration.md (commit ffdcd6c). 1Password-only. Decisions locked: chmod 600 is an applied action (default-Yes interactive, auto in -y); .env walk default depth 2 (covers $HOME/projects/<repo>/.env) with --scan-depth override. 5 implementation phases, 14 acceptance criteria, pre-mortem with mitigations. Open questions: none. Ready to implement.

comments.author: anon-31e9bd66
comments.content: Spec hardened (commit ba51e63): minimal-read discipline (FR1.1), ripgrep-preferred-with-grep-fallback scanner (FR1.2, common-subset regex + LC_ALL=C + errexit safety), and Daria's pre-impl review folded in. Accepted ~all of Daria's findings; rejected only the C3 depth off-by-one (formula N+1 is correct — added an explicit depth table to prove it). Key fixes: forced base-8 stat masking (silent macOS bug), BSD-safe find + -print0, per-finding tier (no sticky leak), value-byte-hardened/re-tiered FP-prone patterns. 19 ACs incl. new errexit/parity/fallback/tier-leak regressions. Open Questions empty — ready to implement Phase 1.
